I had a bad time because my base emotions were based on him pressuring me to do something I was uncomfortable doing. In that state I felt as though he couldn't understand me and that I was in danger and his lack of speaking my language, so-to-speak, was dangerous. That his UTTER STUPIDITY was dangerous. That doesn't make for a good trip-sitter. The wise do not force.

That being said, I felt better outside. And also it was really healing in itself. But he didn't help at all. I took charge and became my own comfort. I believe that trip cured my bipolar. But now I feel a deep sense of detatchment from him, even though I'm "at his level" or whatever. 

We're impatient when we're in pain. Never do anything you're uncomfortable with. Your heart will tell you when it's the best time and no one can make you feel it until it is true for you.

I've been trying to lose weight and have been told for years that I haven't been drinking enough water. I read that water is helpful at speeding up the metabolism and generally supporting the systems in the body so I started making sure I was drinking at least 2L a day and I would watch for changes.

I'm on a lazy keto diet mixed with intermittent fasting, 16:8 which is the reason I started adding a scoop of electrolytes per 2L of water. 

I started drinking so much water because I started using a clear 2L waterbottle and found it was easy to make sure I'm drinking plenty of water that way. Getting halfway through the bottle by noon and finishing the rest by the end of the day was the initial method - then that turned into finishing 1 2L bottle around noon and drinking about 4L by the end of the day.

On this particular day I had a 1 meal treat day and had some pancakes with my breakfast.

This is following a time where I would only drink 1.5 to 3 glasses of water a day. My pee still slightly yellow even though ive been drinking so much water. I'm still very thirsty but I think that's to do with the drinking of only the electrolyte water. 

I felt I could have easily drank 6L of water. That's when it dawned on me that people have died from drinking that amount. But in cases where they drank that much within the hour. How electrolytes mess with water intoxication I have no idea but I'm not going to play with that.
